name: 海洋2000
english_description: The in-game title is Ocean II -- an ES2/Jin Yong-themed mudlib belonging to the "Ocean/hy" code family alongside fqyy2 (Storm Clouds Rising II) in this project, both routing SECURITY_D to adm/daemons/securd.lpc and both authenticating admins through a backdoor id hardcoded into that same daemon rather than a plain-text wizlist (here, "wuyou"). It is also the base for hy2002, a superset that adds roughly 3,000 more files (new maps, new sect content) on top of an otherwise identical 10,630-file map. The world layers a marriage system (d/marry/, d/happy/) on top of the standard Huashan/Wudang/Shaolin/Beggars'-Sect sect map. Deep functional testing walked registration through to a working bulletin-board post/look chain (fixed after finding all 53 boards crashed on post -- the third confirmed cross-family instance of a bug previously only seen in the "Tianya" lineage) and past a security-daemon ACL bug that misjudged an existing skill file as missing and silently aborted NPC creation on the map's first patrol (an identical bug independently confirmed in sibling hy2002). Also fixed: stale MASTER_OB/SIMUL_EFUN_OB macros pointing at dead-code copies instead of the files config.fluffos actually loads, missing-file crashes in the visitor counter and last-crash display, and a leaderboard item spawn on every logout that lacked the defensive check present at four sibling call sites (one of which even left a comment acknowledging the same bug). See NOTES.md.
